newsitem.title: UK: Nycomed chairman to head Nycomed Amersham.
newsitem.headline: Nycomed chairman to head Nycomed Amersham.

text.p: British health and technology group Amersham International Plc said on Tuesday that Johan Fredrik Odfjell, chairman of Norway's Nycomed ASA, had been named chairman designate of Nycomed Amersham Plc.
Amersham and Nycomed announced they would merge earlier on Tuesday.

Amersham said its chairman Richard Lapthorne would become deputy chairman at the merged group. Amersham chief executive Bill Castell would become chief executive officer and Nycomed's Svein Aaser deputy chief executive.
The company said Andrew Allner would become finance director at the merged group and Trond Berger corporate development director.
Nycomed Amersham's board will have 14 members, with six executive and eight non-executive directors drawn equally from both companies.
In addition, both companies will be entitled to nominate one employee representative to the board.
